title: Da Nang tourism is vibrant at night
excerpt: Coming to Da Nang in the summer, tourists will experience new tourist destinations such as night tourism services on Nguyen Van Troi bridge and the east bank park at the foot of Nguyen Van Troi bridge, Bach Dang walking street, 2-9 Square,
html:
Coming to Da Nang in the summer, tourists will experience new tourist destinations such as night tourism services on Nguyen Van Troi bridge and the east bank park at the foot of Nguyen Van Troi bridge, Bach Dang walking street, 2-9 Square, Asia park…

New tourist destinations will bring visitors many new experiences, beautiful virtual living spots, participate in street festivals and many exciting activities.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Da Nang this summer, visitors should walk around the streets, with water music services, cultural and entertainment activities…

This year’s summer products will bring visitors unique experiences, such as art performances combined with fireworks displays, the program will be the highlight of the Da Nang summer tourist season.

Especially the Da Nang night tour programs, which will be performed in the evening, will bring visitors entertainment activities with the show “Awaken River – The River wakes up”, the show “Symphony of River” taking place for the first time in Da Nang and this is also the highlight of the summer travel itinerary.

The performances along with the entertainment program with the participation of international artists and more than 20 athletes performing jestky and flyboards will bring visitors a vibrant summer in the coastal city of Da Nang.

In addition, there are puppet shows every night for visitors to enjoy, and explore the cultural beauty here. It can be said that this is one of the new Da Nang tourism experience products, taking the lead in Da Nang night tourism activities with models such as Son Tra night market, An Thuong night market, Hellio night market, My An night beach at Bach Dang walking street, Nguyen Van Troi bridge, Da Nang Downtown… will contribute to diversifying Da Nang tourism products.
